TravelPhoto.title: TravelPhoto
TravelPhoto.description: Attached HD travel photograph with caption

url.description: HD photo image data URL or URL

isCover.description: Whether this photo is the cover image

DiaryEntry.title: DiaryEntry
DiaryEntry.description: A bicycle touring journal entry with geolocation and photos

id.description: Unique identifier for the diary entry

content.description: Story and body content of the diary

location.description: Geo location data including coordinates and address

photos.description: List of photos attached to the diary

localInsights.description: Local food, recommendations, and solo rider tips

hasSubcollectionPhotos.description: Indicates whether additional attached photos are stored in the subcollection

AppVersionMeta.title: AppVersionMeta
AppVersionMeta.description: Tracks deployed build IDs and sequential deployment version counters

lastBuildId.description: Unique build timestamp identifier from Vite build

updatedAt.description: Timestamp in milliseconds when this deployment was registered

/diaries/{diaryId}.description: Collection of all public bicycle travel diaries. General users have read-only access, only authenticated admin users can create, update, or delete.

/diaries/{diaryId}/photos/{photoId}.description: Subcollection of HD travel photos attached to a diary entry allowing total diary creation up to 2MB

/app_meta/{docId}.description: Stores deployed build version counter metadata under app_meta/version
